<article title="Returns and exchanges">
You can return or exchange unworn items with their tags attached within 60 days of delivery. Start the return from the Orders page, choose the items, and print the prepaid return label. Exchanges for a different size or color ship as soon as the carrier scans your return package.

Items marked final sale, and safety equipment such as climbing hardware, cannot be returned once opened.

Return shipping is free for exchanges. For refunds, a flat 7 dollar label fee is deducted unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

</article>

Customer first name: Freya
<request>
return after 70 days
it has been about 70 days since delivery. the tags are on and it was never worn. can i still return it?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Freya,

Thanks for reaching out. Our returns policy allows unworn items with tags attached to be returned or exchanged within 60 days of delivery. Since your order was delivered about 70 days ago, it falls outside that window, so we're unable to confirm a return based on our standard policy from what we have here.

A specialist will follow up with you to review your situation and any options that may be available.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
